newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 9.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 9.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Parliamentary Chairman Vytautas Landsbergis does not expect Lithuanian President Algirdas Bazauskas to veto the law on the restitution of property, which parliament passed last week, Landsbergis said at a press conference Monday.

- Deputy Transport Minister Algirdas Shakalys said that negotiations with Latvia in Paris over air space control over the Baltic Sea had failed again. The dispute is expected to be solved by the ICAO in July.

- Delegations from Lithuania and Belarus are in talks over the text of a readmission agreement. They are talking about the conditions under which illegal migrants might be returned to the other country
